title: Wedding Invitation
summary: An invitation suite for Serena and Jason's wedding, set bilingually in English and Chinese for guests across both cultures.
blurb: Serena and Jason are loud, funny people, and they wanted an invitation that read like them rather than a formal card. Running the suite bilingually in English and Chinese was the core constraint. Both sides of the guest list had to read the same piece, so the layout was resolved around that before anything else. Cut-out photography, a heavy display face and the couple's own sense of humour do the rest, down to the funky-hat dress code.
